1. Short title and extent. (1) This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.

act_name: West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
heading: Pledging of property to the Bank and recovery of its dues
title: Pledging of property to the Bank and recovery of its dues
text:
2. Pledging of property to the Bank and recovery of its dues. (1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, it shall be lawful for any agriculturist or cooperative society as defined in section 2 of the Agricultural Bank Act, 1957 (XXIII of 1957) (hereinafter called the said Act), or other body corporate of which the majority of members are agriculturists to pledge, mortgage, hypothecate or assign to the Agricultural Bank (hereinafter called the Bank) established under the said Act, any movable or immovable property, in order to secure a loan advanced or to be advanced by the Bank under the said Act.
(2) The Bank shall, in accordance with the provisions of the said Act, be competent to recover its dues by disposal of any property pledged, mortgaged, hypothecated or assigned as aforesaid and nothing contained in any other law shall affect the rights or powers of the Bank conferred on it under the provisions of the said Act, or affect anything done or purported to be done thereunder.
